- Grant pipeline enqueued: yes

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Naom i Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Free credits after signup not showing

Had a look at JIRA-INF-4521 and the grant pipeline traces. TL;DR: the auto-grant webhook returned a 422 because the payload included a legacy "promo_code" field set to an empty string; our validation layer treats that as a malformed coupon attempt and aborts creation. This is a regression introduced by the batching change — we now validate all items together and inadvertently treat empty strings as explicit coupon attempts.

Actions taken:
- Manually created a 200 USD first-run grant for ellie@cloudapp.io (grant id: GR-20260916-889).
- Pushed a small validation fix to ignore empty-string promo_code values and added a unit test for the case.
- Backfilled a reconciliation job to pick up affected signups from 2026-09-12 -> 2026-09-14. Job queued as JIRA-INF-4521-RECON.

Naomi — please confirm with Ellie that the grant is now visible. I included the grant record ID and a short note in the JIRA ticket.

Dev Patel
Staff Engineer, Inference Services
dev_patel@redwood.com
